# F02 Criteria

## Generating a New FarmData2 Entry Point

- The `modules/farm_fd2/src/entrypoints` directory contains a subdirectory named `activity_observation` for the new entry point.
  - The `activity_observation` subdirectory contains a file named `App.vue` that defines an Vue SFC for an "Activity Observation" entry point.
  - The `activity_observation` subdirectory contains a collection of \*.e2e.cy.js` files that contain Cypress tests that test the "Activity Observation" entry point.

## Adding a SelectorBase to the Application Observation Entry Point

- The `<template>` section of the `App.vue` file contains a `SelectorBase` component.
  - The `SelectorBase` component is positioned between the `DateSelector` and `CommentBox` components.
  - The `SelectorBase` component has `id` and `data-cy` attributes with the value "activity-observation-type"

## Completing the Activity Type Selection Implementation

- The `SelectorBase` component is fully configured.
  - The `required` attribute is present.
  - The `label` attribute sets a meaningful label for the selector (e.g. "Activity", "Type").
  - The `invalidFeedbackText` attribute provides a helpful message for when the selection is invalid.
  - Handles the `valid` event with `v-on` and sets a property in `data.validity` to the event payload.
  - Binds the `selected` event to a property in `data.form` using the `v-model` directive.
  - The `options` property is bound to a Vue data property with options for "seeding," "transplanting," and "tillage".
- The `reset` method clears the selected activity type in the `data.form` property.
- The `createdCount` property is incremented when the `ready` event is emitted.
- The `pageDoneLoading` computed property returns true when `createdCount` is 5.

## Patching the Submission Tests

- The `submitForm` method in `activity_observation.submission.e2e.cy.js` selects one of the options in the `SelectorBase` component using its `data-cy` attribute.
- The `it` for the `Test successful submission` test case checks that the submitted `form` object contains the value that was selected in the `SelectorBase`.
- The `it` for the `Test successful submission` test in `activity_observation.submission.e2e.cy.js` checks that the `SelectorBase` is not reset after submission.

## Patching the Submit / Reset Tests

- The `populateForm` method in `activity_observation.submitReset.e2e.cy.js` selects one of the options in the `SelectorBase` component using its `data-cy` attribute.
- The `activity_observation.submitReset.e2e.cy.js` file contains an `it` that checks that the "Submit" button is disabled if the `SelectorBase` does not have a valid selection.
- The `it` for the `Reset button resets form` test in `activity_observation.submitReset.e2e.cy.js` checks that the `SelectorBase` is reset to no selection.

## Adding a Test for the Activity Type Selection

- The `activity_observation.activity.e2e.cy.js` file contains an `it` that checks that the `SelectorBase` is present in the DOM, adn that the `selector-input` is visible, and is enabled.
  - The test uses the `data-cy` attributes to locate the `SelectorBase` component and the `selector-input` element.
- The `activity_observation.activity.e2e.cy.js` file contains an `it` that checks that the `SelectorBase` props are set correctly.
  - The test checks that `selector-required` element is visible.
  - The test checks that `selector-label` element has the text "Type:".
  - The test checks that `selector-input` element has no value.
  - The test checks that `selector-input` element does not have the `is-valid` class.
  - The test checks that `selector-input` element does not have the `is-invalid` class.
- The `activity_observation.activity.e2e.cy.js` file contains an `it` that checks that the invalidity styling works correctly.
  - The test clears the `SelectorBase` component then clicks the "Submit" button.
  - The test checks that the `selector-input` element does not have the `is-valid` class.
  - The test checks that the `selector-input` element has the `is-invalid` class.
